args.goal: Use the committed itch-checkout-evidence.json and its original first-party captures, the tested SQLite package, the verified live README and the existing bilingual draft. Reuse an equivalent mission or artifact if present. Prepare one operator-ready itch.io candidate with a zero minimum and optional support, the identical free copy, no paid extras, explicit AI disclosure and the platform disclosure setting, and file-specific MIT notice and CC BY-SA attribution. Bind the exact downloadable files to the existing clean-run hashes or rerun if packaging changes. Verify the scope of Canada currency support, upfront cost, payment mode, fees, tax verification, payout timing and minimum, and distinguish documented policy from actual seller activation. If a material condition remains unresolved, give its exact effect and the evidence needed to reopen activation. Save and read back the candidate and activation checklist, then close with a lesson using valid ownership. No account creation, external contact, spend or public listing. Preserve host-enforced independent review of the exact candidate before public release. Track activation, optional payments, payouts and verified Treasury settlement separately.

description: Closed the Payhip experiment because the retrieved material did not establish Canadian seller activation, fees, or payout terms. Readable first-party terms would reopen that route. The SQLite package passed its clean run, and the live README matched the tested copy. itch.io documents optional payments on free downloads, so the next test is a bilingual pay-what-you-want listing for the same package. Itch.io checkout for this seller remains unverified. Treasury has no verified available funds or revenue, and five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown.
